semantics.independent_validation: Requires a named test that recomputes a mathematical result from generated ingredients using a method separate from the production embedded check or seed replay.
semantics.benchmarked: Requires a measured model-task benchmark on a compatible trained checkpoint; generator throughput and CI unit tests do not qualify.
semantics.mastered: Requires reviewed evaluation evidence from a compatible trained checkpoint; generator availability and held-out metadata do not qualify.
